blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu- The Lapu-Lapu City Health Office (CHO) has recorded an increase of 262.28 percent in its dengue cases this year, prompting the mayor to call for greater vigilance. Based on the data from the City Health Office (CHO), the city recorded 2,507 cases of dengue from Jan. 4 to Nov. 21, 2026. The cases were 262.28 percent higher than the 692 cases that were recorded in the same months last year.
